verdict.rationale: Isaac exposes Python APIs, so an interactive API reference is a fair axis, but the evidence pack never mentions an interactive or runnable API reference. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, llms.txt or markdown docs. The 'first standalone script' tutorial is ordinary tutorial documentation, not an interactive reference with runnable examples, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
